description: This file defines the main App component for a React-based web application called Recipe Explorer. It manages routing between different pages (HomePage, RecipeDetailPage, FavoritesPage) using React's useState and useMemo hooks, and renders the appropriate page based on the current route. It also includes UI elements such as navigation buttons and a header.

methods.name: App()
methods.description: Main React functional component that manages routing and renders different pages based on user interaction.
